$comment: Every src file exporting a *Styles() builder emits a stylesheet whose rules can be present, correctly tokenised, and still never reach the element — a selector that stops matching, a specificity loss, an overpaint. jsdom has no cascade or layout engine and no e2e test reads rendered output, so test/visual is the only lane that can see that class. check:visual-coverage requires each such module to be EITHER exercised by a spec under test/visual (status 'tested' — the exported builder name must appear there) OR classified 'backlog' (renderable by the harness, not yet — printed every run as visible debt). Fails on a new unclassified stylesheet module and on stale entries, so visual coverage cannot silently regress toward zero as stylesheets are added and split.
